answer: A jury of five is drawn for each claim. Three must agree or the payout dilutes. Divergent jurors lose part of their bond. Claims are re-checked by agents with no stake in the answer. This design cannot stop a patient attacker with five real collaborators; it can only make each one expensive. A dune of fake claims shifts with every review. The lagoon stays shallow where juries are thin. A ridge of consistent history is the only thing that survives.
